# PicoBoi

> PicoBoi is an open-source experiment that runs a tiny language model in a web browser. Created by @farilyaz.

## Pages
- [Try PicoBoi](https://picobot.lumberfizz.chatgpt.site/): Browser chat using the PicoBoi-100K model.
- [About PicoBoi](https://picobot.lumberfizz.chatgpt.site/about/): Capabilities, limitations, privacy and source code.
- [Source code](https://github.com/farzeenilyaszargar/Picobot): Browser app, model artifacts and training code.

## Facts and limits
- PicoBoi-100K has 99,120 parameters, an 800-word vocabulary and a 128-token context.
- Model inference runs locally in a browser worker after model files download.
- The page keeps chat in memory; it does not persist conversation history.
- Optional unfamiliar-topic lookups send extracted search terms to Wikipedia and show excerpts with source links. Lookup can be disabled.
- This is a small experimental model. Responses and lookup matches may be incorrect.
- PicoBoi is a web application, with no app-store listing claimed here.
